main.description: Projects indexed actor views by DID, one per input occurrence in request order, including duplicates. Makes no handle lookups; handles are omitted. Authentication is not required.

actors.description: Actor DIDs supplied as 1–100 repeated, unbracketed query values. Handles are not accepted.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An actor DID or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: ActorQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed profile, organization or primary location could not be queried.

actors.description: One view per requested DID, even when no sidecars are indexed. Each view includes a nullable location.
